question: The passage presents the findings of a United Nations report which is mainly regarding
solution:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'the world population.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **first** sentence of the **second** paragraph says that "**The world's population**, estimated to reach 8 billion by November 15 this year, could grow to 8.5 billion in 2030, and 10.4 billion in 2100, as the pace of mortality slows, said the report released on World Population Day."
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say that the passage presents the findings of a United Nations report which is mainly regarding the world population.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 3.
